output.reason: The only evidence, [ev-ade0be673ee4], is the bare dependabot line for the distroless/static digest bump. It says nothing about any effect. The locator also puts this line under "BREAKING CHANGES › What's Changed". That doesn't show anything breaks, but it does mean the evidence can't prove the bump is harmless.
